# I Want to Change My Life

> A comprehensive mental health resource offering evidence-based guides, self-assessment tools, and therapeutic techniques for anxiety, depression, PTSD, and addiction recovery.

The site provides DSM-5-aligned diagnostic information, CBT worksheets, and practical strategies for mental health management. Created by Dr. Steven M. Melemis, it combines clinical rigor with accessible self-help resources for individuals and families seeking mental health support.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- DSM-5 Criteria
- Anxiety Disorders
- Depression Treatment
- Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)
- Social Anxiety Disorder
- Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
- Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD)
- Bipolar Disorder
- Panic Disorder
- Antidepressants
- Mindfulness & Meditation
- Addiction Recovery
- Family Support
- Stress Management

## Anxiety Disorders

- [Anxiety: Symptoms, Disorders, Definition, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/anxiety/anxiety-symptoms-disorder.htm): Comprehensive guide to anxiety symptoms, disorders, and DSM-5 definitions
- [Generalized Anxiety Disorder - GAD: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/anxiety/generalized-anxiety-disorder-gad.htm): GAD guide with DSM-5 criteria, GAD-7 test, and treatment overview
- [Social Anxiety Disorder: Symptoms, Definition, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/anxiety/social-anxiety-disorder.htm): Social anxiety disorder guide with DSM-5 criteria and SPIN screening test
- [Anxiety Attacks - Panic Disorder: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/anxiety/anxiety-panic-attacks.htm): Panic disorder and anxiety attacks guide with DSM-5 diagnosis criteria
- [Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder - OCD: Symptoms, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/anxiety/obsessive-compulsive-disorder-ocd.htm): OCD guide covering symptoms, compulsions, DSM-5 diagnosis, and treatment
- [Agoraphobia-Panic Disorder: Symptoms, Definition, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/anxiety/agoraphobia.htm): Agoraphobia guide with DSM-5 criteria and diagnostic assessment tools
- [Specific Phobias Guide: Symptoms, Definition, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/anxiety/specific-phobias.htm): Specific phobias guide with DSM-5 criteria and diagnostic assessments

## Depression & Mood Disorders

- [Depression: Symptoms, Test, Definition, Causes, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/depression/depression-symptoms-treatment.htm): Depression guide with DSM-5 criteria, self-assessment, and treatment options
- [Bipolar Disorder Guide: Symptoms, Test, Causes, Diagnosis](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/depression/bipolar-disorder.htm): Bipolar disorder guide covering Bipolar I, II, mania, and DSM-5 criteria
- [Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder - PTSD: Symptoms, Test, Treatment](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/ptsd/post-traumatic-stress-disorder.htm): PTSD guide with symptoms, DSM-5 diagnosis, and trauma recovery strategies

## Therapeutic Approaches & Techniques

- [Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Guide, Free CBT Worksheet, Thought Record](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/cbt/cognitive-behavioral-therapy-guide.htm): CBT guide with thought record worksheet and cognitive therapy techniques
- [Stress Management, Meditation, Mindfulness Introduction](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/stress/stress-management-meditation-mindfulness.htm): Introduction to stress management, meditation, and mindfulness practices
- [How to Meditate - Mindfulness: Step-By-Step Guide](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/stress/how-to-meditate-mindfulness.htm): Step-by-step meditation and mindfulness guide for beginners

## Medications & Pharmacological Treatment

- [Antidepressants: Choices, Side effects, Benefits, Guidelines](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/medications/antidepressants.htm): Antidepressant guide with side effects, benefits, and treatment guidelines
- [Anti-Anxiety Medication-Benzodiazepines: Facts, Uses, Side-Effects](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/medications/anti-anxiety-medication.htm): Benzodiazepine guide covering Valium, Ativan, Xanax with addiction risks
- [St John's Wort-Hypericum for Depression: Side Effects, Dosage](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/medications/st-johns-wort-hypericum-depression.htm): St John's Wort herbal supplement guide with dosage and side effects

## Support & Resources

- [Family Support: Dealing with Anxiety, Depression, Addiction, PTSD](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/family-support/families-anxiety-depression-addiction-ptsd.htm): Family support guide for caregivers dealing with mental health conditions
- [I Want to Change My Life by Dr. Steven M. Melemis](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/book.htm): Self-help book by Dr. Steven Melemis on anxiety, depression, and recovery

## Optional

- [Book Reviews of I Want to Change My Life by Dr. Steven Melemis](https://iwanttochangemylife.org/book-reviews.htm): Reviews of Dr. Melemis's self-help book from Kirkus and Amazon
